Armed men have killed at least 37 civilians in an ambush in western Niger near Burkina Faso and Mali, local sources said on Friday.  
  
Ruled by a military junta since a 2023 coup, Niger is battling violence by jihadists linked to Al-Qaeda and the Islamic State group.  
  
Thousands have been killed in the violence over the last decade.

results.snippet: Military leaders in Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger overthrew democratically elected governments, arguing that those governments had failed to suppress long-running insurgencies that junta leaders claimed they could put down.
